-* Separate native resistive clock common-mode conditioner prototype.
-.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
+* Separate v2: both native upward-bias rppd lengths8 to6.4um; all other devices unchanged.
+.subckt nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt_v2 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
 XSP clkp ckp sub rppd w=4u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1

-XUP avdd ckp sub rppd w=1u l=8u b=0 sw_et=1

--- clock_div4_hbt_v5.spice

@@ -1,10 +1,10 @@
 * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Hasan Melih Akbulut
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: CERN-OHL-W-2.0
-* Separate v5: two limiter collector loads L4.0 to4.4um; all guards unchanged.
+* Separate v6: first conditioner uses L6.4 pull-ups; limiter and sampler remain unchanged.
 * The first core retains its upward common-mode network. The second network
 * lowers the first core's high output common mode; no ideal level shift.
-.subckt nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v5 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
-XFIRST clkp clkn s1p s1n avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt
+.subckt nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v6 clkp clkn qp qn avdd avss sub
+XFIRST clkp clkn s1p s1n avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_conditioned_hbt_v2
 * Real input bias, limiter reference and differential pair; no ideal gain.
 XLSP s1p bip sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
 XLSN s1n bin sub rppd w=2u l=3.6u b=0 sw_et=1
@@ -25,4 +25,4 @@
 XCP lp ckp cap_cmim w=20u l=20u
 XCN ln ckn cap_cmim w=20u l=20u
 XSECOND ckp ckn qp qn avdd avss sub nssoc_clock_div2_hbt
-.ends nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v5
+.ends nssoc_clock_div4_hbt_v6

Graph guard checks437identities and only xchain.xdiv.xfirst.xup/xun params.l; unchanged VCO hybrid889R765C; disconnect and actual modulus fault preserved.
Eleven existing source controls cover four graph configurations, invalid terminal/width/length/ideal-bias changes, frozen execution guards; read saved pass log, no repeated test or native run.
